description: This PHP source file defines the IVSRealTimeClient class in the AWS SDK, providing method annotations for interacting with Amazon Interactive Video Service RealTime (IVS). It extends the AwsClient class and includes method signatures for various operations like creating, deleting, getting, and listing resources related to IVS in a real-time context.

classes.name: IVSRealTimeClient
classes.description: Client class for Amazon Interactive Video Service RealTime, providing methods to manage encoder configurations, ingest configurations, participants, stages, storage, and other IVS resources.

methods.name: createEncoderConfiguration
methods.description: Creates a new encoder configuration for IVS RealTime.

methods.name: createIngestConfiguration
methods.description: Creates a new ingest configuration for IVS RealTime.

methods.name: createParticipantToken
methods.description: Generates a token for a participant to join a staging session.

methods.name: createStage
methods.description: Creates a new stage for real-time interactions.

methods.name: getStage
methods.description: Retrieves details of a specific stage.

methods.name: getParticipant
methods.description: Gets information about a participant in a stage.
